summary.overall_verdict: Discover/source-planning did not surface the five official/commercial series the thesis needs. The Explore catalog ranked desk seats (LSEG, CRSP, TWSE, GDELT, BigQuery) instead of BPS silastik, marketplace GMV, PMSE VAT, Bank Indonesia payments, or WBES Indonesia. research_plan_sources repeatedly offered Indonesia equity/GDELT derived panels. research_search_catalog was empty on every phrasing. research_web_discover (Zenodo) found adjacent items: an academic Indonesia e-commerce user survey (not BPS microdata), a public-analytics payments paper (not official PMSE/BI tables), and WBES papers for other countries. Closest KPI path is Refinitiv analyst consensus / LSEG, which is EPS/ratings not GMV/GTV. Verdict: index miss for this procurement question; web layer only partly helpful.
